items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: I used to play with them a while... Used to play rock and roll with them, see?

ctx.x: Let's get your name down. I don't think I did get it. The Valentine. You're another Valentine, though. That's my son. You're a junior then, huh? Yeah. Oh, I see.

That's, that's, uh, Freddie and his son. Oh, I like that. He went out, but going off there. Oh, I see. He's still playing music now, huh? I used to play with them a while, but after they broke the band down, to fire.
What kind of music did you play, personally? I used to play piano. No, but I mean, did you play Dixieland or Progressive or everything?
